name: zep-hd-curated
description: F-216 curated HD collection: exactly the model/texture files picked in the model viewer, pulled from the community HD packs (Asset Library). Generated by `zep model curate --apply` straight into mpq/parsed-assets - no source-assets, so the resource parser never runs over already-parsed files. Ship with `zep build patch-mpq -p Q --build`.
author: Zeppelin Team
